f32b67f6aba2ddf85683.en: The new session of the Newtalk News Legislative Yuan opened on the 29th, and it will usher in the 116-year central government general budget review again. In response to the offense and defense of the new session budget, Kaohsiung City Council candidate Huang Jingya publicly called on Kuomintang legislator Ke Zhi 'en to do his best as a legislator, and truly remember the painful lessons brought by the Kuomintang's malicious cup of 115 annual general budget last year. Never harm the development of Kaohsiung again, and never drag down Taiwan's hundred industries again. Huang Jingya first said that he hoped that Ke Zhi 'en would find the courage to speak out to the party and Fu Zhao, putting the rights and interests of Kaohsiung citizens before the calculation of the political party, and stressed that in addition to the many funds related to the welfare of the people and the development of the hundred industries, the 116th annual general budget also led to many ongoing major local construction in Kaohsiung and the improvement of the functions of life in the south. It is inadmissible to be blocked by political calculations. Huang Jingyae Land

According to the judgment of the Kaohsiung District Court, both Ms. Zheng and her boyfriend, surnamed Chen, were in the habit of using drugs. After Zheng Daughter was released from prison in September of the Republic of China, she and Chen lived together in a rented house on Zhongshan 2nd Road, Lingya District, Kaohsiung City. The two of them repeatedly used drugs in the living room of the residence with a glass ball barbecue. The police checked and found that the child Zheng, who was in the same room at the time, developed physical and mental discomfort due to long-term inhalation of second-hand toxic smoke. The Kaohsiung Municipal Social Affairs Bureau was reported to intervene and verified, and the police reported to the police on November 21, 114.
